text:
Maya (CS): FYI - customer (Sameer @Acme) just reported that after the v2 rollout their JSON output stopped matching schema. sending details below, escalating to eng/runtime + ml. :warning:

Sameer (Acme): Repro steps i posted a minimal request at 10:12am UTC. Expected strict schema: all items array entries should be objects. After the rollout ~09:50 we started getting nulls and missing fields. Here's the request i sent:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-llama2-compat-v2","input":"Generate order JSON for items","temperature":0.0,"max_tokens":300}'
```
Expected response schema (simplified):
```json
{"order_id": "string", "items": [{"name":"string","price":number,"qty":number}], "metadata": {"source":"string"}}
```
Actual response sample (received):
```json
{"order_id":"ORD-1001","items":[null,{"name":"Widget","price":19.99}],"metadata":{}}
```
Note: the first array element is null, and metadata keys are empty. This used to never happen on v1.

Maya (CS): Customer attached request_id: req_0ab12c and timestamp 2026-03-12T10:12:31Z. They reported this started immediately after the prod rollout that completed ~09:50 UTC. Can eng repro?

deploy-bot: :rocket: rollout completed: redwood-llama2-compat-v2 -> 100% production at 2026-03-12T09:50:12Z (deploy id: d-8273)

Alex (ML Eng): thanks, pinging in. initial hypotheses: 1) system or assistant prompt changed serialization instructions, 2) model regression in structured output tokenization, 3) quantized kernel change that alters generation of separators.
Can you paste the exact full prompt (including system messages) and the model_version header value returned in response headers? Also confirm temperature=0.0 for all tests.

Sameer (Acme): Full payload i used is above. We don't set system messages explicitly (using default). temperature=0.0, top_p default. Response headers from the API included: `x-model-id: redwood-llama2-compat-v2` and `x-request-id: req_0ab12c`. No explicit model_version header.

Priya (Runtime): I pulled logs for req_0ab12c from the trace store. Snippet: 
```
[2026-03-12T10:12:31Z] req=req_0ab12c model=redwood-llama2-compat-v2 runtime_instance=i-03a4f trace_id=tr-9f2
[...kv-cache lookup...] prefix_cache.hit=false batch_sz=1 tokens=42
[generator] top_tokens sampled count=1 temp=0.0
[serialize] structured_out_detector=on -> detected format=json but field_alignment=partial
[response] items[0]=<NULL_TOKEN> items[1]=object
```
Seems the runtime's structured_out_detector flagged partial alignment and a NULL_TOKEN was emitted. Not seeing exceptions.

Alex (ML Eng): interesting - structured_out_detector=on is the new heuristic that triggers a light post-processing pass to coerce outputs into JSON. That component had a small change in v2 to be more permissive for trailing commas and missing values. It looks like in some sequences it replaces short malformed spans with explicit NULL_TOKEN to avoid parsing errors. That explains the nulls, but we need to know why it started happening more often. Did we change any token-mapping or merge a new tokenizer patch in this rollout?

Priya (Runtime): Yes, we deployed tokenizer patch tkn-2026-03 that normalizes certain punctuation sequences to a single token to improve throughput on A100-80GB. It landed in the same deploy. I'll link the diff: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/commit/tkn-2026-03 (private). Could be related.

Zoe (Product): Note for context: we did not include the structured-output canary test in this rollout (missed in release checklist). We should open a post-rollout regression ticket and add structured-output schema tests to the canary suite. cc @eng-qa.

Maya (CS): Customer is asking for a mitigation now. Is there a quick server-side toggle we can flip to restore previous behavior (disable structured_out_detector or pin to v1)?

Priya (Runtime): Short-term mitigation options: 1) pin routing for this customer to `redwood-llama2-compat-v1` via account routing API, 2) enable runtime flag `strict_json_passthrough=true` for their workload which bypasses the permissive post-processing and returns raw model tokens (this preserves prior behavior but may surface small parse errors instead of nulls). To pin model for customer id AcmeCorp-33: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/AcmeCorp-33/routing \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-admin' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"route":{"model":"redwood-llama2-compat-v1","percent":100}}'
```
I can apply the strict_json_passthrough toggle on their session if product signs off.

Alex (ML Eng): I'll reproduce locally by running the exact prompt with both tokenizers (pre and post patch) and with and without structured_out_detector to confirm. If it's the tokenizer change, we should revert patch tkn-2026-03 from the runtime or ship a fix to structured_out_detector to handle the new tokenization.

Sameer (Acme): Pinning to v1 would be fine as a temporary fix. We need production traffic back to baseline ASAP. Appreciate the quick help. :pray:

Zoe (Product): I'll create a Priority P1 internal ticket and mark as blocking for the deploy change log. Also updating the release checklist to require structured-output canaries.

Maya (CS): Action items summary: 
- Priya to apply routing pin or strict_json_passthrough for Acme (short-term) (ETA: 30m)
- Alex to reproduce and confirm root cause (ETA: 2-4h)
- Priya/Runtime to prepare rollback of tokenizer patch if repro confirmed (ETA: depends)
- Zoe to file regression ticket and update release checklist (ETA: 1h)

Priya (Runtime): I've started the routing change; will post request id once complete.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: routing update applied for account AcmeCorp-33 -> redwood-llama2-compat-v1 (req=rout_5521)

Maya (CS): Thanks everyone. Sameer, i've applied the pin and asked them to validate. If they still see issues we'll reopen and escalate.

Sameer (Acme): Confirmed - after pinning to v1 the malformed nulls are gone. Thank you! :tada:

Alex (ML Eng): confirmed repro locally with tokenizer patch + detector ON. Will open a PR to make the detector robust to the token normalization and add unit tests against the structured-output eval set.

Maya (CS): Closing the customer-facing loop. Keeping this thread open for engineering follow-ups. :v:
